Question 6

The mass m of a tablet PC measures 314.7g to the nearest tenth of a gram. Determine the upper and lower bounds of this measurement.

a
 314.695g≤m<314.705g
b
 313.7g≤m<315.7g
c
 314.65g≤m<314.75g
d
 314.6g≤m<314.8g
e
 314.69g≤m<314.71g
